source: Official Vinamilk Annual Report 2020, page 22; source PDF URL is recorded in data/vietnam_enterprises/manifest.json.
reference_method: Manual transcription of readable poster text from the rendered source PDF page; visually checked against the original page image.
clip_coordinates: PDF points [x0, y0, x1, y1], top-left origin; the poster is embedded as raster imagery in a born-digital PDF.
limitations: One Vietnamese product-poster region from an official report. This is embedded raster artwork, not a physical scan. Ground truth includes the clearly readable headline, brand and principal package claims; tiny package copy, decorative text and non-text content are excluded. One page is a plumbing/quality pilot, not a model-selection dataset; layout regions and table cells are not annotated.
